description: NOAA/CIRA AIWP reforecasts (Pangu-Weather IFS, GraphCast IFS) 2-m temperature for Zamboanga del Norte LGUs.

source.caveat: Pre-processed static extract; not real-time. Values are nearest-grid-point 2-m temperature, bilinear interpolation between grid cells is display-only. 6-hourly samples aggregated to PHT calendar-day tmax/tmin.

pangu_ifs.attribution: Pangu-Weather (Bi et al., Nature 2023) via NOAA/CIRA AIWP archive (Radford et al. 2025, BAMS). Public S3: noaa-oar-mlwp-data.s3.amazonaws.com.
pangu_ifs.exclusionReason: Non-commercial weights (BY-NC-SA 4.0); surfaced for transparency/attribution but excluded from the independent-consensus median so the system can remain deployable into non-commercial and public-facing contexts without ambiguity.

graphcast_ifs.attribution: GraphCast Operational (Lam et al., Science 2023; Google DeepMind) via NOAA/CIRA AIWP archive (Radford et al. 2025, BAMS). Public S3: noaa-oar-mlwp-data.s3.amazonaws.com.
graphcast_ifs.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial per checkpoint metadata; NOAA/CIRA AIWP redistribution)
graphcast_ifs.exclusionReason: Non-commercial weights (BY-NC-SA 4.0); surfaced for transparency/attribution but excluded from the independent-consensus median.
